review_auto_entities.title: Review automatically detected entities

Verified, Community, and reliable Auto-detected entities are preselected. Experimental and Suggested entities require review. You can still add entities manually.

Product: `{product_id}` · category: `{category}` · protocol: `{protocol_version}` · entities: {entity_count}. Observed DPS: `{observed_dps}`. Required DPS: `{required_dps}`. Initial status: `{confidence}`. Suggested file: `{filename}`. Local key, device ID, IP address, Cloud credentials and friendly names are not included. Nothing is uploaded automatically.

Device: **{device}**

Runtime loaded: {runtime_present} · connected: {runtime_connected}
